note: Each forge pull request (FOSDEM/website) is mirrored by one or more GitHub pull requests on the fork, current one first. A GitHub pull request is closed only after the forge one is closed or merged, never before. GitHub and forge numbers are unrelated: GitHub #11 is not forge #11. scripts/check-upstream-prs.py reports the state of each pair and never closes anything.
